summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its capital reduction approved on March 12, 2026 became fully effective after the expiration of the legal period on May 14, 2026. The company will return R$1.25171862845 per common share (based on ~3.195 billion shares outstanding, excluding 30.9 million treasury shares) to shareholders, payable on July 14, 2026 in a single installment. The ex-reimbursement date is May 22, 2026. This is a routine capital return, not a tender or self-tender offer. Tax treatment varies by shareholder residence, with withholding for non-resident shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing confirms the execution of a previously approved capital reduction, distributing excess capital to shareholders. No regulatory clock or break fee applies.
